QuestInfo.name: Hero's Gladius
QuestInfo.0: After much hardship, I finally managed to gather all the materials #p602# asked for. Now, I can only trust in his power.
QuestInfo.1: With #p602#'s help, I awakened the #t1302009#, entrusted to me by #p502#, into the #t1302014#. All that remains now is to return the sword to #p502#.
QuestInfo.2: It seems that this #t1302014#, which #p502# told me about, is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing between the #b#t1302014##k and the #b#t1032013##k that #p502# offered me, but I don't regret my choice.

0.0: I don't know who left you with this, but please tell that person that this sword is meant to be used for good. My work is done. So long...

1.0: Yes... it is this sword indeed, the sword that saved me then...!
1.1: What do you think...? Are you going to keep the #t1302014#, or are you going to return it to me like you promised? If you return it, I'll reward you with the earrings that my friend left me with before he passed away.

item.0: What happened to #t1302009#? Have you still not awakened it?

npc.0: What became of the sword I awakened for you? I only hope it has been put to good use...
